decisionDataset.caseTitle: Uppsala Recorded Research Case (SE_UPPSALA · Fixed 16-Policy M14 Corpus)
fieldRecommendationBlockedReasons: ABSTAIN_NO_ALL_SCENARIOS_SERVICE_PASS: 0 of 16 tested sequences satisfy <=100 mm crop ET deficit across all 9 scenario states (F1/F2 rainfed deficit >=165.47 mm in DRY_ANCHOR_2018).
FIELD_RECOMMENDATION_ELIGIBILITY = BLOCKED (BLOCKED; no independent field/rights/response qualification).
UNQUALIFIED_CROP_PROXY: Secale cereale winter rye uses FAO-56 Table 12/22 winter wheat exploratory proxy coefficients; no field/soil/N/rights calibration exists.
IN_SAMPLE_SELECTION_BIAS: Same3 historical windows already used in M10 tuning; in-sample analysis, not independent validation.

climateDataset.syntheticDisclosure: RECORDED NASA POWER METEOROLOGICAL ARCHIVE — Observed daily PRECTOTCORR & T2M_MIN/T2M_MAX from verified POWER_2006_2025.json (SHA f231ad6a...). Daily modeled ET0/ETc/deficit traces are omitted (null) because only raw weather inputs and scenario-level M14 summaries are bundled.

m14EvidenceRecords.variable_label: Daily Gridded Precipitation & Air Temperature (2006–2025 UTC)
m14EvidenceRecords.spatial_support: 0.625° lon × 0.5° lat MERRA-2 grid cell centered near [17.65, 59.82]; NOT field rain gauge
m14EvidenceRecords.missingness_summary: Verified complete native JSON; missingness preserved via null without zero imputation.
m14EvidenceRecords.uncertainty: Regional meteorological reanalysis; does not measure sub-kilometer convective rainfall or field soil moisture.
m14EvidenceRecords.license: NASA POWER public-access attribution (MERRA-2); no NASA endorsement.
m14EvidenceRecords.extraction_recipe: POWER API v2.10.3 daily point query (https://power.larc.nasa.gov/api/temporal/daily/point?parameters=PRECTOTCORR%2CT2M%2CT2M_MIN%2CT2M_MAX&community=AG&latitude=59.82&longitude=17.65&start=20060101&end=20251231&format=JSON&time-standard=UTC)
limitations: Regional grid cell (.625°×.5°), not a surveyed farm weather station.
Historical 2006–2022 windows are retrospective benchmarks, not 2027–2031 weather forecasts.

m14EvidenceRecords.variable_label: 16 Candidate Policies × 9 States (144 Cases: 90 PASS / 45 FAIL / 9 INVALID_CALENDAR)
m14EvidenceRecords.spatial_support: SE_UPPSALA fixed 3-field assumption set (F1 6ha rainfed, F2 8ha rainfed, F3 10ha irrigable)
m14EvidenceRecords.units: m³ equivalent shortfall/regret; mm harvest deficit
m14EvidenceRecords.quality: Max daily mass balance residual <= 6.93e-14 mm (SCIENTIFIC_ACCEPTANCE)
m14EvidenceRecords.missingness_summary: 9 INVALID_CALENDAR cases (10e4f587b144b38bae9d) strictly nulled; 0 synthetic zero-fills.
m14EvidenceRecords.uncertainty: Conditional on M8 crop/soil/resource assumptions and Windows Python 3.14.3 IEEE-754 evaluation.
limitations: 0 of 16 candidates pass <=100 mm in all 9 scenario states (NO_ROBUSTLY_FEASIBLE_POLICY).
In-sample comparison on the same 3 historical windows used in M10 search.
FIELD_RECOMMENDATION_ELIGIBILITY = BLOCKED (no legal water rights, soil/N/yield validation).

m14EvidenceRecords.variable_label: Finite Delivery Cap Grid [20, 80, 200] m³/day & 165.473239/165.473240 mm Bracket
m14EvidenceRecords.spatial_support: SE_UPPSALA F1/F2/F3 model domain (F1 rainfed floor)
m14EvidenceRecords.units: mm per field harvest year; m³/day source/pump cap
m14EvidenceRecords.quality: 1e-6 mm grid bracket around raw F1 deficit 165.47323956605408 mm
m14EvidenceRecords.missingness_summary: Discrete finite grid only; supply monotonicity is explicitly FALSE.
m14EvidenceRecords.uncertainty: 165.473239566... mm is conditional first-season model ET deficit, NOT biological crop survival limit.
limitations: Bracketed numerical sensitivity, NOT a safe agronomic drought tolerance threshold.
Changing pump capacity on F3 cannot rescue rainfed parcels F1 and F2.

m14EvidenceRecords.variable_label: Exploratory FAO-56 Wheat Proxy & SJV Sowing Advisory (Unqualified Field Calibration)
m14EvidenceRecords.spatial_support: Literature proxy parameters (not local field-trial measurements)
m14EvidenceRecords.quality: ASSUMED_NOT_OBSERVED — winter rye (Secale cereale) relies on FAO-56 winter wheat Kc/root proxy
m14EvidenceRecords.missingness_summary: No mineral N process coupling, no yield curve, no price/cost optimization.
m14EvidenceRecords.uncertainty: High agronomic transfer uncertainty; blocks all field-level recommendations.
m14EvidenceRecords.license: Factual metadata only; no full FAO/SJV document redistribution.
limitations: Explicitly UNQUALIFIED_GRAIN_RYE_EXPLORATORY_WHEAT_PROXY in M8 ASSUMPTION_REGISTER.json.
Stage dates and winter freeze suppression assumed, not observed.
